pattern: Native form control with a <label for> association (HTML); the consumer's element keeps its native role.

roles.role: Native role of the wrapped element (textbox, spinbutton, combobox/listbox for <select>, ...)

aria.value: Help text and visible error ids, followed by ids the consumer had set before creation
"true" only while an error message is shown
Native attribute, set from the required option when given

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the control.
Native behavior of the element (editing, arrow stepping, select picker).

focus: The control shows the shared control focus indicator (border in color-focus-ring plus a ring); forced-colors mode uses a Highlight outline.
notes: The required asterisk is aria-hidden; the native required attribute conveys the state.
Native validation bubbles are suppressed (the invalid event is prevented) so only the AbsoluteUI message is shown and read.
Errors appear after the first blur by default; when focus left because a pointer was pressed elsewhere, the message renders after the pointer is released so the click is not displaced.
Existing aria-describedby references (for example an external hint) are kept and restored on destroy.
knownCaveats: Behavior with every native input type has not been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
